name: PakListings
description: PakListings is Pakistan's business directory: find local businesses, companies, professionals and jobs across 183 cities and 24 categories, or list a business from PKR 99, one-time. Public content is readable without credentials via the public pages, the free read-only JSON API (/api/v1/businesses, documented at /openapi.json), and the MCP server (POST /api/mcp).

skills.name: Search businesses
skills.description: Find businesses on PakListings by keyword, city, or category.

skills.name: Browse cities and categories
skills.description: Browse the 183 cities and 24 categories covered by PakListings.

skills.name: Read blog guides
skills.description: Read practical guides for Pakistani business owners on the PakListings blog.

skills.name: Use the public read-only API
skills.description: Search businesses and read categories/cities as JSON from /api/v1/* — free, no key, 60 requests/minute per IP. Documented in /openapi.json.
